source.context: Example spectrogram for a Mw 4.8 St Paul transform-fault event on 2012-07-09
source.paper_interpretation: Arrivals in the 5-25 Hz band spaced at approximately 20-second intervals and visible at multiple EA hydrophones were identified as likely airgun shots associated with exploration activity on the west African margin.

why_topa_keeps_it: This is an unusually clean cross-domain lesson for Tesla Sweep: a highly regular pulse train can propagate over a large oceanic sensor network and appear alongside genuine geophysical events while having a mundane engineered source. Periodicity plus multi-station detection is therefore not enough to infer a message or an unknown source.
future_candidate_rule: Any candidate promoted partly because of regular pulse spacing must be scored against this airgun-class control and other scheduled-transmitter families using the full physical fingerprint, not pulse count alone.
